baseline_scope: The dev.3 review carried engine measurements forward. This comparison uses the original dev.2 raw outputs, not the older 1.3.0 published table.
timing_interpretation: The final run uses turbo on under BIOS 1836, microcode 0x133, 253 W sustained and short-term limits, and 4 x 32 GiB at 4,200 MT/s. It pins every timed command to identical efficiency cores and audits the policy at every start and once per second. The dev.3 review used turbo on with the old BIOS. Power limits and memory speed can change absolute seconds, so historical absolute-time ratios do not isolate implementation changes; matched tool-to-tool speed-up ratios are the comparison of interest. The historical log records END loads, not start loads or selected-core contention. Millisecond R timings also have coarse relative resolution. Final tool-to-tool speedups use only this fresh, consistently configured run.
